title: A design system you own: UI, AI and layout elements for React.
description: React components copied into your repo as plain source. UI elements, AI elements for chat and agents, and layout primitives, with no wrappers and no SDK. An llms.txt index, raw markdown docs and installable skills so your AI reads the same thing you do.
